prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Bruce Lee roster owner; one image.
Primary request: Create an original Bruce Lee portrait matching the accepted project collectible miniature design opened in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-bruce-lee-codex/design/bruce-lee-front.png. Follow that miniature's face, hair, yellow suit, craftsmanship and palette. It is a newly painted miniature portrait, not a photograph, movie still, avatar photo, commercial scan or reproduction of published game art.
Scene/backdrop: plain empty charcoal gray background, no scenic elements.
Subject: lean adult East Asian martial artist Bruce Lee, strong high cheekbones and defined angular jaw, straight firm dark eyebrows, focused dark-brown eyes, clean-shaven face, closed lips and a calm intent expression. Short dense black hair with thick sculpted locks swept forward into the reference's textured fringe, modest sideburns and ears visible. Wear the accepted golden-yellow round-neck martial-arts jumpsuit, fine dark piping at the neck, clearly visible nearly-black stripe over each shoulder and down the upper sleeves. Show both shoulders and upper chest. Preserve the approved miniature's character identity and natural warm tan skin; no headgear, jewelry, weapons, props or hands.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted tabletop MINIATURE bust, crafted resin sculpture with controlled anatomical planes, sculpted hair locks, fine restrained brushwork, painted skin shadows and matte yellow cloth folds. Clearly miniature craftsmanship with clean material separation, not photographic human skin, beauty portrait, hyperreal avatar or wax museum photography. Match the project's collectible figure quality without adding costume details.
Composition/framing: square 1024-by-1024 composition. One CENTERED head and shoulders, face nearly frontal, eyes level and fully visible. Use a deliberately wide crop with generous blank headroom: highest hair lock around 18 to 20 percent below the top edge; whole head, all hair, both ears and neck inside the central 55 percent of canvas width. Eyes near 43 to 46 percent down the canvas. Upper shoulders taper toward lower corners. All hair and facial silhouette should sit comfortably inside an imagined central inscribed circular crop at full100; do not actually draw a circle or mask. Avoid filling the square with a giant face; preserve breathing room over and beside the head.
Lighting/mood: gentle soft studio key with balanced fill; both eyes readable, restrained sculptural shading, no dramatic colored rim light, bloom, smoke or effects.
Color palette: approved golden suit yellow #E0B830, stripe black #141414, warm tan skin #C49A74, near-black sculpted hair; natural shaded paint variations, neutral charcoal backdrop.
Constraints: one original head-and-shoulders portrait, whole hair/head fully inside canvas with generous headroom. No letters, numbers, captions, logo, watermark, UI, border, badge, circular frame, medallion, layout, collage, extra person, hand, weapon, plinth, background scene or copied commercial artwork. Preserve the approved project design's face, hair and suit; no smile, head tilt, extreme perspective or obscured eyes.
